name: Operit AI
tagline: An AI helper that can actually use your phone
description:
Operit AI is a chat assistant that can also do things for you on your phone — open apps, tap around, run little scripts and work through a task step by step instead of only answering questions.

You plug in your own AI service key, and everything else lives on your device. It comes with a toolbox of built-in skills and lets you add more.
